_comment: Each source has seed URLs to fetch and rules for which links to follow. follow.include/exclude are regexes tested against the absolute URL; maxPages caps pages per source per run. Set enabled=false to skip a source. bases lists which home bases the source is relevant to. Add town tax-collector pages to the ct-town-notices source as you find them.

sources.name: Connecticut municipal tax sales (cttaxsales.com)
sources.note: Parsed by lib/adapters/cttaxsales.js; each parcel's PDF notice is read for assessed value, acreage and amount due.

sources.name: Connecticut Judicial Branch foreclosure sales
sources.note: Pending foreclosure sale postings by town. Town list limited to the eastern half of the state; extend as needed.

sources.name: Town tax collector notices (Windham and Tolland counties)
sources.note: Add the tax-collector or legal-notice page of each town you care about, e.g. Ashford, Eastford, Woodstock, Pomfret, Union, Willington, Mansfield, Chaplin, Hampton, Stafford.
